messages.text: Where is my order? Order #Shop····, email (email hidden)

Hi Ripal, nothing has changed since we spoke: the order is paid and still to ship, and the BSB B30 with the Power K. goes out together on November 7. Your Power K. is already set aside at our Chattanooga warehouse and the B30 is what we're waiting on.

You can follow that shipment on its way to us here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

Tracking comes to this email the moment the box leaves. Anything else I can check?
